parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the 'Wallpaper' package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and therefore carries sample-app semantics. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record is a sample-app file must be treated as intentional duplication. The production copy in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel) should not be coupled to the sample-app mirror in WallpaperSampleApp; the duplication is load-bearing for the demonstration context.
